privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.device: Without an account, your cabals, your current game and the tournaments you follow stay in your browser (local storage on this device): nothing is sent to the server. With an account, a copy of your cabals also stays on each device, to use them offline.
privacy.account: With an account, the server keeps your username, your email address, a fingerprint of your password (never the password itself), your saved cabals, and the creation and last sign-in dates. A session cookie, which is required, keeps you signed in for at least 3 months, extended when you come back; there is no advertising and no audience measurement.
privacy.email: Your email address is only used to recover your account (confirmation, forgotten password): never displayed, never shared, no newsletter. Emails go through a sending service.
privacy.tournaments: In a tournament, your name and your lists are visible to participants; a tournament is erased 90 days after its last change (once its date has passed). The statistics kept afterwards are anonymous. Your IP address is only used to limit abuse, in memory, without being stored.
privacy.delete: You can delete your account at any time from "My account": it is erased at once, along with your email address.
